The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lomabu III]] was the site of a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''penal colony''' for [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], operated by the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Aida sector/Legends|Aida sector]], [[Io Desnand]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], The Wookiees were [[Mission to Lomabu III|rescued]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Chenlambec]].
